decisive_items: Mix of small to large B lymphocytes
response.rationale: Biopsy shows large B cells with aberrant BCL2 and high Ki-67, typical of DLBCL; CD5/CD10 negativity and lack of rearrangements favor DLBCL over Hodgkin or PEL.

rejected.why: NLPHL typically shows CD20+ small/large cells with CD15/CD30 negative, but lacks aberrant BCL2 and high Ki-67 pattern; also no Reed-Sternberg variants described.
Primary effusion lymphoma requires HHV8/HIV association and usually lacks solid nodal mass; here extensive adenopathy and biopsy findings are not supportive.
